LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_FarBelow: I am far too skinny. Every bone in my body feels sharp, prominent and cold.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_Below: I'm too skinny. I feel a bit too bony and light in my own skin.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_SlightlyBelow: I'm almost where I want to be. Just a tiny bit more weight to feel solid.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_Preferred: This is perfect. I feel light, lean and sharp in all the right ways.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_SlightlyAbove: I feel too soft. There's a layer of flab that doesn't belong on me.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_Above: I'm fat. I hate how heavy and soft I feel in this skin.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_FarAbove: I'm revolted by this size. I'm a soft, round mess of useless fat.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_FarBelow: This is unacceptable. I should be so much bigger, rounder and heavier than this.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_Below: I imagine myself much rounder. I want to feel a deep, soft wobble every time I shift.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_SlightlyBelow: So close. I can almost feel the roundness I want.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_Preferred: That's a lot of fat, and it's all mine. I like the weight, the softness, and the sheer size of me.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_SlightlyAbove: Fat and happy has a limit, even for me. I'd like a little less of this. Just a little.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_Above: I love the softness, but I'm too heavy for my taste. It's simply too much.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_FarAbove: I want to be fat, but not this fat. There is far more of me than I actually want to carry.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_General_FarBelow_Alter: The body I want is much heavier than this. I hate being so far from that size.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_General_Below_Alternat: Something is missing. I don't feel the heaviness I want.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_General_SlightlyBelow_: Nearly my size. Just a tiny bit of extra weight to finish the feeling.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_General_Preferred_Alte: This is it. I am the perfect amount of person.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_General_SlightlyAbove_: I'm a bit heavier than my ideal. It's not a disaster, but I'd rather be slightly lighter.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_General_Above_Alternat: I'm too big. There is a heavy roundness to me that feels wrong.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_General_FarAbove_Alter: I'm practically a beanbag. Far more of me than I want.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_FarBelow_Alternat: This is pathetic. I feel like a skeleton wrapped in thin, fragile skin.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_Below_Alternate: I'm too light. My edges feel slightly too sharp for my own liking.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_SlightlyBelow_Alt: Nearly a complete person. I just need a sliver more substance to fill out.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_Preferred_Alterna: I love being thin. This is my sort of body, and I wouldn't trade it for a heavier one.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_SlightlyAbove_Alt: This softness is annoying. I can feel a slight, unwanted jiggle when I move.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_Above_Alternate: There is too much weight. This extra roundness is a real annoyance to me.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Lean_FarAbove_Alternat: I'm way too fat. I feel huge, heavy and completely wrong.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_FarBelow_Alternate: I want more fat on me. When I picture the size I'd love to be, this just doesn't come close.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_Below_Alternate: Not enough fat. I want to be much heavier.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_SlightlyBelow_Alte: Almost there. Just a bit more fat and I'm set.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_Preferred_Alternat: So much of me to love. Being fat suits me, and I'm not about to pretend otherwise.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_SlightlyAbove_Alte: I'm a little too round, but I love being fat. This softness is just a touch excessive.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_Above_Alternate: I feel like a boulder. All this roundness is too heavy, even for me.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_Fat_FarAbove_Alternate: I'm an absolute sphere. This massive, soft roundness is far beyond what I want.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_ExtremeWish_1: I wish I were so fat I filled the whole bed. That's the size I dream about.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_ExtremeWish_2: I want to be massive. I picture deep, heavy rolls covering every inch of me.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_WeightStruggle_1: God, I'm so fat that getting across the room is a chore. I wish I had less weight to drag around.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_WeightStruggle_2: All this extra fat is making it hard to move. I'm way past the weight I can comfortably handle.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_HipWish_Gain: My hips need more width. I can see myself filling a whole chair with soft, heavy fat.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_HipWish_Loss: A bit too much weight here. The extra width on my sides is a nuisance.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_LegWish_Gain: My thighs should be huge. I dream of them pressing together with every single step.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_LegWish_Loss: Too much fat on my legs. This softness makes them feel heavy and clunky.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_BellyWish_Gain: I want a proper fat belly. Something big and soft that feels like the body I dream about.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_BellyWish_Loss: I'd like less belly to carry around. A smaller one would suit me much better.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_ChestWish_Gain: I wish there were more fat on my chest. A heavier, softer chest is exactly what I want.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_ChestWish_Loss: My chest is too heavy. I feel a soft roundness that is just unnecessary.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_ArmWish_Gain: Give me more weight. I picture my arms as thick, soft rounds of fat.
LanguageData.RR_BodyPreference_ArmWish_Loss: These arms are too thick. This extra softness is more than I like.
